name: customize: a 40 × 20 × 10 block
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openContent('blk.scad', 'cube([40, 20, 10]);'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); return 'ok'; })()

name: customize: Keyboard — a shortcut recorded from a key press runs its command; a default turned off does nothing; reset brings the defaults back
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('customize'); await sleep(200); const page = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="ck.section"][data-value="gestures"]') && document.querySelector('[data-pm^="ck.record:"]')); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('ck.query', 'measure'); await sleep(100); const filtered = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm^="ck.record:"]')].length; m.actions.pmCommand('ck.record:measure'); await sleep(100); const waiting = Boolean(document.querySelector('.custom-capture')); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'm', code: 'KeyM', altKey: true, bubbles: true })); await sleep(100); const kept = m.state.settings.keyBindings['Alt+M']; m.actions.pmCommand('ck.unbind:Ctrl+B'); await sleep(50); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await sleep(100); const calls = { measure: 0, rebuild: 0 }; const om = m.commands.measure.run; const ob = m.commands.rebuild.run; m.commands.measure.run = () => { calls.measure++; }; m.commands.rebuild.run = () => { calls.rebuild++; }; const key = (k, code, mods) => document.body.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, code, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...mods })); key('m', 'KeyM', { altKey: true }); key('b', 'KeyB', { ctrlKey: true }); await sleep(100); m.commands.measure.run = om; m.commands.rebuild.run = ob; const b = m.custom.bindings(); const listed = (b.byCommand.get('measure') ?? []).join(); await m.run('customize'); await sleep(100); m.actions.pmCommand('ck.resetKeys'); await sleep(50); const reset = Object.keys(m.state.settings.keyBindings).length === 0 && m.custom.bindings().byCombo.get('Ctrl+B') === 'rebuild'; await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ page, filtered: filtered >= 1 && filtered < 20, waiting, kept, calls, listed, reset }); })()

name: customize: Toolbar — My tools tab first with its commands in order, a toolbar group, a tab hidden
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('customize'); await sleep(100); m.actions.pmSet('ck.section', 'toolbar'); await sleep(100); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.add:userTab:massProps'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.add:userTab:measure'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.add:userTab:walkthrough'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.up:userTab:walkthrough'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.add:userTab:view:top'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.del:userTab:massProps'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.add:toolbarExtra:recordVideo'); m.actions.pmToggle('ct.tab:sheetMetal', false); await sleep(200); const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-tab')].map((b) => b.dataset.cmTab); document.querySelector('.cm-tab[data-cm-tab="user"]').click(); await sleep(150); const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-buttons [data-command]')].map((b) => b.dataset.command); const extra = Boolean(document.querySelector('#toolbar [data-command="recordVideo"]')); return JSON.stringify({ first: tabs[0], sheetHidden: !tabs.includes('sheetMetal'), btns, extra }); })()

name: customize: Toolbar — undone: no My tools tab, no added group, every tab back
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.del:userTab:walkthrough'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.del:userTab:measure'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.del:userTab:view:top'); m.actions.pmCommand('ct.del:toolbarExtra:recordVideo'); m.actions.pmToggle('ct.tab:sheetMetal', true); await sleep(150); const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cm-tab')].map((b) => b.dataset.cmTab); return JSON.stringify({ user: tabs.includes('user'), sheet: tabs.includes('sheetMetal'), extra: Boolean(document.querySelector('#toolbar [data-command="recordVideo"]')) }); })()

name: customize: Gestures — on; a right-drag shows the eight commands round the pointer (picture)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); m.actions.pmSet('ck.section', 'gestures'); await sleep(100); m.actions.pmToggle('cg.on', true); m.actions.pmSelect('cg.dir:2', 'view:top'); await sleep(100); const selects = document.querySelectorAll('[data-pm-select^="cg.dir:"]').length; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await sleep(100); const cv = m.viewport.canvas; const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__g = { x: r.left + r.width / 2, y: r.top + r.height / 2 }; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { clientX: window.__g.x, clientY: window.__g.y, button: 2, buttons: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: window.__g.x + 6, clientY: window.__g.y - 60, buttons: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: window.__g.x + 8, clientY: window.__g.y - 90, buttons: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); await sleep(200); return JSON.stringify({ selects, guide: Boolean(m.viewport.gesture), labels: m.custom.gestureLabels().filter(Boolean).length }); })()

name: customize: Gestures — letting go runs the Up command (top view); a right click still opens the context menu; off again
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const cv = m.viewport.canvas; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: window.__g.x + 8, clientY: window.__g.y - 90, button: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); await sleep(900); const dir = m.viewport.cameraState().dir; const top = dir[2] > 0.99; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { clientX: window.__g.x, clientY: window.__g.y, button: 2, buttons: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: window.__g.x, clientY: window.__g.y, button: 2, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); await sleep(200); const menu = Boolean(m.popups.frames.get('menu')) && m.state.openMenu === 'context'; m.popups.closeAll(); await sleep(100); m.actions.updateSettings({ gestures: { enabled: false, map: m.custom.gestureMap() } }, { quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ top, guideGone: !m.viewport.gesture, menu }); })()

name: customize: Templates — the block saved as a part template; a new part from it has its feature; as the default, File › New uses it (blank: not)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('templates'); await sleep(150); const section = m.state.editing?.section; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('tp.name', 'Block 40'); m.actions.pmCommand('tp.save:model'); await sleep(150); const list = m.custom.loadTemplates(); const tpl = list.find((x) => x.name === 'Block 40'); const row = Boolean(document.querySelector(`[data-pm="tp.new:${tpl.id}"]`)); await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.custom.newFrom(tpl.id); await sleep(800); const fromTpl = { feats: m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'), named: m.state.doc.project.name !== 'blk' }; m.custom.setDefault(tpl.id); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); await sleep(800); const byDefault = Boolean(m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad')); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(500); const blank = !m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); m.custom.setDefault(tpl.id); return JSON.stringify({ section, kind: tpl.kind, row, fromTpl, byDefault, blank, defaultOff: !m.state.settings.defaultTemplates.part }); })()

name: customize: Templates — a drawing template (A2, company) laid on a new drawing; exported to a file and imported back; deleted
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openContent('blk2.scad', 'cube([30, 30, 8]);'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); i++) await sleep(200); await sleep(300); const partRef = { ...m.state.doc.project.active }; await m.actions.newDrawing(); await sleep(400); m.actions.change('op.drawing', (p) => { const d = p.drawings.at(-1); d.sheet = 'A2'; d.title.company = 'ACME'; d.title.drawnBy = 'Kim'; }); await sleep(100); const dt = m.custom.addTemplate('Sheet A2', 'drawing'); m.actions.switchDocument(partRef); await sleep(300); const made = await m.custom.newFrom(dt.id); await sleep(400); const nd = m.state.doc.project.drawings.at(-1); const applied = { sheet: nd.sheet, company: nd.title.company, drawnBy: nd.title.drawnBy, two: m.state.doc.project.drawings.length === 2, own: nd.id !== m.state.doc.project.drawings[0].id }; let text = null; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { text = { name, content }; return true; }, () => m.custom.exportTemplate(dt.id)); const back = await m.custom.importTemplate(text.content); const n = m.custom.loadTemplates().length; for (const x of m.custom.loadTemplates()) m.custom.deleteTemplate(x.id); return JSON.stringify({ applied, file: /Sheet A2\.mymechtpl$/.test(text.name), imported: back?.kind === 'drawing' && back.drawing.sheet === 'A2', n, left: m.custom.loadTemplates().length }); })()
